# XL Marinade

> Deterministic Excel formula-graph extraction to SQLite.

XL Marinade is a deterministic Excel formula-graph extractor that turns .xlsx/.xlsm workbooks into a queryable SQLite database, with an optional bring-your-own-key LLM documentation tier.

## AI agents

- [Plugins](https://marinade.gaspatchio.dev/ai/setup/index.md)
- [Skills](https://marinade.gaspatchio.dev/ai/skills/index.md)
